artifacts.summary: Implementation summary: question-by-file table for the twelve questions, the two items awaiting the user ruling with options and recommendation, the stale task descriptions and roadmap rationales, and the verification record.

completion_data.completion_summary: The three records under records/ state ten of the twelve questions as decided design with the rejected alternative, keep (i) and the Until/Since keyword question open with a recommendation, and point (f) at investigate_stability_as_modal_family; the three review drafts for PRs #7, #8 and #9 state the decisions. Phase 5 found the six files consistent after one fix to the Gates section of records/proof-mode.md. Nothing was posted to GitHub.

memory_candidates.content: When a closing phase must compare a verify-touched.sh fallback run against a planning-time baseline, attribute each extra failing suite before deciding: run it alone, grep it for the touched paths, and cmp it and its subject against the source store named in .claude-extensions.json. A suite that reads only the gitignored .claude/ tree cannot be moved by an edit to tracked markdown, and that evidence supports a Reasoned Exclusions record instead of a failed phase.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic records, questions still open after the PR-review decisions
sapience_notes.value: Of the twelve questions raised by the reviews of PRs #7, #8 and #9, ten are stated as design in the records. Three remain open: what default means for adoption (M12), awaiting the user, recommendation B as the rule plus A for Examples and case studies with FormalSystem/Theorems exempt, contingent on a GO at gate one; whether luntil unfold / luntil fold are renamed expand / contract, awaiting the user, recommendation rename; and whether the stability operator is rightly in the Modal family, deferred to investigate_stability_as_modal_family.
sapience_notes.source_loc: records/proof-mode.md, Open decisions; records/proof-mode-architecture.md, Open decisions

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic task descriptions contradicting the revised proof-mode records
sapience_notes.value: The descriptions of proof_mode_reprove_perpetuity, proof_mode_until_since_intro_unfold_induction, proof_mode_abstract_frontend_interface, proof_mode_views_tier and theorem_library_layout_and_registry in specs/state.json each still call a question open or needing a user ruling that the records now decide: gate-one rule set, the induction rule linearity edge, structure versus class and the Minus instance, the views tactic names, and BimodalLib in defaultTargets. investigate_stability_as_modal_family and theorem_library_tableau_pipeline cite surviving open decisions by stale numbers. None was edited.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic proof-mode milestone order M17, M0, M16 and the gate
sapience_notes.value: Logical rewriting (M17, collaborator PR #7) is merged or declined first, then the operator-family layout (M0) runs, then the views tier (M16) follows and takes over the view rows M17 contributed. Neither M16 nor M17 waits on the gate-one verdict: a view proves nothing, and M17 tactics are outside the gate-one scripts; only M17 second run of the gate-one selection follows the sweep.

sapience_notes.subject: BimodalLogic deployed agent-system test suites failing on 2026-11-20
sapience_notes.value: In the BimodalLogic deployed .claude tree, verify-touched.sh with the --cost-class free fallback reported 82 passed, 3 failed, 10 skipped at 12:28 PST where a run about half an hour earlier reported 84 passed, 1 failed. Beyond test-deploy-baseline-lib.sh, the failures were test-lint-state-writer-boundary.sh (the --verbose EXEMPT reason for an explicit r open) and test-stall-reprompt-wiring.sh (the Move 3 region not OR-ing stall_suspected and stranded_suspected). Both fail when run alone and are byte-identical to the core source store, so the defect or the drift is in the source store, not in the consumer repository.
